title: ComfyUI Hires Fix Ultra All-in-One Node
summary: A comprehensive custom node for ComfyUI that streamlines the high-resolution fix process by consolidating multiple upscaling steps into one interface. It includes built-in tiled VAE processing and color correction to prevent OOM errors and desaturation during latent upscaling.
research_notes: Regarded as a faster, more user-friendly alternative to Ultimate SD Upscale for daily 1.5x–4.0x image enhancements.

evolution.summary: The project evolved from a complex 6-node workflow into a single-node solution to eliminate 'spaghetti' workflows in ComfyUI. Recent updates have integrated Deep Histogram color matching and improved compatibility with FLUX.1 models via ComfyUI Manager.
